title: Vitamin C and the common cold
text: Regular vitamin C supplementation did not reduce the incidence of colds in the general population, but modestly shortened their duration.

title: Zinc lozenges
text: Zinc acetate lozenges taken within 24 hours of onset shortened the duration of common cold symptoms in adults.

title: Statins and cholesterol
text: Statins lower LDL cholesterol by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase and reduce cardiovascular events in high-risk patients.

title: Mediterranean diet
text: A Mediterranean diet rich in olive oil and nuts reduced major cardiovascular events in a primary prevention trial.
Coffee consumption was associated with a lower risk of type 2 diabetes in a large prospective cohort.

title: Green tea catechins
text: Green tea catechins had a small effect on body weight in overweight adults across randomised trials.
